name: rally.raid Earth Repair
description: Rally repair menu for rally.raid Earth stages (click its bar, or REPAIR in the GPS app): mid-stage wheel change, light suspension and radiator repairs (time added to the stage), whole-car repair and engine change at the bivouac (3 h budget), spare wheels and resets left, RECOVER CAR (the one reset allowed in a stage, two steps: ask, then confirm) and resuming a stage saved before a game crash (RESUME). Buttons only by default; any of these can be given a key in Options > Controls.
author: wyans (rally.raid Earth)
